id.description: Unique identifier of the booking in the TourRadar system.

tour.description: Information about the tour that was booked.

tour_id.description: Unique identifier for the tour in the TourRadar system.

tour_length_days.description: Length of the tour, expressed in number of days.

id.description: Unique identifier for the tour operator in the TourRadar system.

departure_date.description: Departure date that was booked, in the format `YYYY-MM-DD`.

return_date.description: Return date from the tour, in the format `YYYY-MM-DD`.

email.description: Email used for communications regarding the booking (agent or lead passenger).

created_at.description: Exact timestamp of when the booking was created, in the ISO 8601 format.

hold_expire_at.description: If the booking record is a `hold`, this will be the exact timestamp of when the hold expires, in the ISO 8601 format.

price_category.description: Defines the price category applied for this passenger.

title.description: Name of the passenger category (for example: adult, child).

age_min.description: Minimum age requirement for this category, if applicable.

age_max.description: Maximum age requirement for this category, if applicable.

fields.description: Passenger data. A list of all possible field names and properties can be obtained using the **[/operators/{operatorId}/booking-fields](#tag/Operators/paths/~1v1~1operators~1{operator}~1booking-fields/get)** endpoint.

confirmed_at.description: Exact timestamp of when the booking was confirmed, in the ISO 8601 format. If the status of the booking is not `confirmed`, this field will be `null`.

locale_code.description: Identifier of the guide language for this booking.

last_message.description: Information relative to the last message in this booking's conversation channel. Messages are not available for direct bookings.

author.description: Author type of the message. `system` is for automatically generated notification messages, the other types reflect the role of the user who posted the message.

created_at.description: Exact timestamp of when the message was sent, in the ISO 8601 format.

partner_info.description: Information relative to the partner that made the booking.

id.description: Unique identifier of the partner in the TourRadar system.

agent_id.description: Identifier of the agent (user) that made the booking. Note: this is only relevant for bookings made on the TourRadar website.

store_id.description: Identifier of the store, or agency, that made the booking. Note: this is only relevant for bookings made via the TourRadar Partner API.

contract_type.description: Contract type that was applied for this booking.

calculation_base.description: Definition of the amount used as reference for the commission calculation.

commission_rate.description: The commission rate, expressed as multiplier. For example, a commission of 5% would be represented by `0.05`. If no commission will be paid for booking this tour, this will be `0`.

commission_value.description: The actual commission value, calculated on the price reported in this section.

booking_fee_rate.description: The booking fee rate, if any, expressed as multiplier. For example, a booking fee of 5% would be represented by `0.05`. If no booking fee will be due for booking this tour, this will be `0`.

booking_fee_value.description: The actual booking fee value, calculated on the price reported in this section.

operator_booking_code.description: Booking code or reference number in the operator system.

partner_booking_code.description: Booking code or reference number set by the partner when creating the booking.

custom_data.description: Additional info set by the partner when creating the booking. Up to 5 string properties can be set in it.

status_reason_text.description: The full description of the declination reason, if set.

status_reason_context.description: Additional information related to the current status, if set.

accommodations.description: The accommodations related to the booking.

optional_extras.description: The optional extras related to the booking.

mandatory_addons.description: The mandatory addons related to the booking.

BookingDeclineReason.description: The reason of the declination, if set.

price_category_id.description: Id of the price category related to the price.

pax_count.description: Number of passenger for which this price is applied.

price_per_pax.description: Price of the extra for each passenger.

price_category_id.description: Id of the price category related to the passenger.

passenger_id.description: Id of the passenger related to the extra.
